notes: End-times broadcaster who folded Y2K into prophecy programming and sold a tape on it. Died 2020. Secondary figure for the episode; one line at most.

name: Steve Hewitt
motive_notes: None documented -- argued against the panic while the panic was the profitable position.
notes: Travelled the country trying to calm Y2K fears, pointing out that businesses and governments were already fixing the real problems. Called the Christian Y2K alarmists irresponsible in print in Feb 1999, before the date. Afterward pushed for accountability and got Michael Hyatt to respond with an apology letter. The 'someone said it out loud at the time' figure -- far stronger than our narration making the point.

name: Peter de Jager
motive_notes: Consulting work on remediation; publicly opposed doomsday profiteering.
notes: Raised the early alarm about the date problem in 1993, which is what got remediation started. Later separated himself from the collapse crowd. Useful to the episode as proof that warning about a real bug and selling the apocalypse are two different acts. Verify specifics before scripting.

name: Robert F. Bennett
orgs: US Senate Special Committee on the Year 2000 Technology Problem
notes: Chaired the Senate Y2K committee. Said publicly, contrary to the doom crowd, that Y2K would not produce the doom-and-gloom scenarios. Committee's final report concluded the $100B spend was justified and the threat had been real. Died 2016.

name: Christopher J. Dodd
orgs: US Senate Special Committee on the Year 2000 Technology Problem
notes: Vice chairman of the Senate Y2K committee. The committee was bipartisan, which matters: the fix was not a partisan project.

name: John Koskinen
notes: Chaired the President's Council on Year 2000 Conversion. Credited by the Senate committee's final report with coordinating public and private sector preparation. The man who actually did the boring work that made the non-event happen -- the anti-story the fear industry never told.

name: James Wickstrom
orgs: Posse Comitatus; True Church of Israel
motive_notes: Movement authority; framed Y2K collapse as vindication.
notes: CAREFUL -- explicit antisemitism. Predicted total failure of banks, registers, pensions and deliveries, and said he was 'ecstatic' about what was coming. Wrapped it in a claim that Jewish bankers were hiding the danger to prevent a bank run. Documented via the ADL report and the FBI's Project Megiddo. Method only in any video -- do not replay the smear, do not quote the antisemitic content on screen. Died 2018.

name: Norm Olson
motive_notes: Movement recruitment during a fear peak.
notes: Quoted in the FBI's Project Megiddo predicting constitutional rights would be suspended before the crisis hit, and calling it 'the worst time for humanity since the Noahic flood.' Documents the martial-law lane that Jones was also running on Dec 31 1999.

name: Hank Hanegraaff
motive_notes: None documented -- argued against the panic.
notes: Warned in Oct 1999 that people who made life decisions on Y2K predictions would leave the church afterward, asking 'if you guys were so wrong on a current event, how can you be correct on something that happened 2000 years ago?' Predicted the trust damage before it happened.
